personality_one_liner: A high-tech, tactical command center that values speed, contrast, and raw utility.

spacing.rule: Dense and intentional. Use structural dividers rather than large empty gaps. Keep metrics tightly grouped.

do's: Use heavily tinted frosted glass for the floating left vertical rail over the live camera view.
Use glassmorphism for the AI confidence overlay results to maintain context of the underlying photo.
dont's: Do not use glass for text inputs or static data rows on the profile/history screens.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Live camera viewfinder with a vertical left navigation rail and bottom capture controls.

states.loading: Camera initializing skeleton with a subtle crosshair pulse.
states.error: Camera permission denied message with a high-contrast 'Grant Access' CTA.

screens.layout: CRITICAL: Do NOT use a bottom tab bar. Use a full-bleed `expo-camera` as the background. On the LEFT side, float a vertical `expo-blur` rail (pill-shaped, heavily tinted `surfaceSecondary`) containing 4 icons: Profile, History, Help, and Pro Subscription. Position it vertically centered or slightly aligned to the top, respecting `useSafeAreaInsets().left` and `top`. At the bottom center, place a large circular shutter button. At the bottom right, float a small gallery upload button. The camera feed is the absolute hero here.

screens.name: ScanResult
screens.purpose: Overlays the captured image with a tactical, high-tech AI detection confidence reading.

states.loading: Simulated scanning animation (horizontal laser line looping over the image) with monospace 'ANALYZING...' text.
states.error: Failed to analyze image; retry button.

screens.layout: The captured image remains full-bleed. Overlay a dark gradient scrim (top-to-bottom). In the center or lower-third, display the verdict using large condensed display typography (e.g., 'AI DETECTED 94%'). If AI, use `brandPrimary` (Neon Orange). If Real, use `success` (Matrix Green). Under the verdict, show a technical monospace breakdown of 'Confidence factors' or 'Model: Claude 3.5 Sonnet' in a frosted glass card. Include a 'Back to Scanner' floating button at the top-left or bottom-center.

screens.name: ScanHistory
screens.purpose: A dense, utilitarian list of past scans with thumbnail, verdict, and timestamp.

states.loading: Skeleton list of raw data rows.
states.empty: No scans yet. Matrix-style terminal text: 'LOG EMPTY_'.

screens.layout: A stacked, dense list. Use `surfaceSecondary` for rows. Left side of row: small square image thumbnail. Right side: Monospace timestamp (top), bold verdict tag using `brandPrimary` or `success` (bottom). Use 1px `border` dividers between rows instead of gaps. Dark, sharp, and highly scannable.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Account settings and Google Login state.

states.empty: Logged out state showing Google social login button.

screens.layout: Use a stark, command-center layout. Avatar at the top inside a `brandTertiary` container. A prominent 'Sign in with Google' button with the Google logo PNG. Settings are dense list rows with right chevrons. Minimal fluff, pure utility.

screens.name: Subscription
screens.purpose: RevenueCat paywall to unlock Pro features ($9.99/mo or $79.99/yr).
screens.layout: A cinematic, dark overlay. Use an abstract digital texture background. A large 'PRO' badge. Two large toggleable cards for Monthly and Annual plans. The selected plan uses a `brandPrimary` 1.5pt border outline. A large sticky primary CTA ('UPGRADE TO PRO') at the bottom thumb zone.

screens.name: Help
screens.purpose: FAQ and how the AI detection works.
screens.layout: Editorial but technical. Monospace headers for questions, readable body text for answers. Use high contrast and structural dividers.

camera_background_mock.alt: Woman walking across a sunny city street, used as camera viewfinder mock

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility personality: use pure Obsidian backgrounds (#0D0D0D) with strong Ember/Neon Orange (#FF4D00) accents. Avoid generic grays or standard blue tints entirely.

CRITICAL LAYOUT REQUIREMENT: On the Home Screen, DO NOT implement a standard bottom tab bar. The home screen MUST be a full-bleed camera view. Create a floating `vertical_rail` on the left edge of the screen using `expo-blur`. Place the 4 requested tabs (Profile, History, Help, Subscription) as stacked icons inside this floating vertical pill.
Ensure the Capture button is absolute positioned at the bottom center of the Home screen, and the Gallery upload button at the bottom right.
Use Archivo for large display metrics and percentages on the ScanResult screen, and IBM Plex Mono for technical logs, timestamps, and confidence factors.
For the AI Result, emphasize 'Probabilistic-UI': show a scanning animation first, then a clear bold verdict ('AI DETECTED' in brandPrimary, 'REAL' in success) over a heavy dark gradient scrim.
Implement the Google social login button on the Profile screen using the exact provided Google logo image.
Embed subtle haptics: heavy impact on camera shutter, light impact on side rail taps, and success/warning feedback on scan completion based on the verdict.
Do not use emojis anywhere in the app interface.
